## Summary
Hetav Shah is an Associate AI Engineer at ProductSquads and a CS student at Adani University. He specializes in building production-grade Agentic AI solutions, multi-modal document extraction pipelines, and serverless event-driven AI assistants on AWS.

## Core Technical Skills
- Agentic AI & RAG: LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP (Model Context Protocol), Vector Databases
- Languages & Frameworks: Python, TypeScript, Next.js, React, Node.js
- Cloud & DevOps: AWS (Cloud Architecting & Developing certified), Docker, NixOS, Serverless

## Key Projects
- Deep Research Agent: Autonomous AI research workflow system
- GDPR RAG: Compliant RAG pipeline for data privacy regulations
- QnA App: Interactive question-answering system
